tools.name: read_text_file
tools.description: Read a UTF-8 text file from disk and return its full contents as a string. Use this for source code, config, and markdown. Use read_file_bytes instead when the file may be binary or large.

path.description: Absolute path of the file to read, e.g. /home/me/notes.txt.

max_bytes.description: Truncate the returned content after this many bytes. Defaults to 1 MiB.

tools.name: read_file_bytes
tools.description: Read a file as base64-encoded bytes without decoding it as text. Use this when the file may be binary (images, archives) or when exact byte fidelity matters. Returns an object with `encoding`, `size`, and `content`.

path.description: Absolute path of the file to read.

max_bytes.description: Truncate the returned content after this many bytes.

tools.name: write_text_file
tools.description: Write a string to a file, creating it if it does not exist. Returns the number of bytes written. Fails if the parent directory does not exist unless `create_parents` is true.

path.description: Absolute path of the file to write.

content.description: UTF-8 text to write. Overwrites the file unless `append` is true.

append.description: Append to the file instead of overwriting it.

create_parents.description: Create missing parent directories before writing.

tools.name: delete_path
tools.description: Permanently delete a file or directory. This is not recoverable and does not use the trash. Use this only when the user explicitly asked to remove something. Set `recursive` to delete a non-empty directory.

recursive.description: Delete a directory and everything inside it. Required for non-empty directories.

tools.name: list_directory
tools.description: List the immediate children of a directory. Returns an array of `{ name, type, size }` where `type` is one of `file`, `directory`, or `symlink`. Does not recurse; use search_files for that.

path.description: Absolute path of the directory to list.

include_hidden.description: Include entries whose name starts with a dot.

tools.name: search_files
tools.description: Recursively search for files by name pattern or content regex under a directory. Returns matching paths with line numbers for content matches. Use this instead of list_directory when you need to find something rather than enumerate.

root.description: Absolute path of the directory to search from.

name_pattern.description: Glob matched against the basename, e.g. `*.ts`. Omit to match all files.

content_regex.description: JavaScript regular expression matched against file contents. Omit to search by name only.

tools.name: stat_path
tools.description: Return metadata for a path: size in bytes, modification time as an ISO-8601 string, permissions, and whether it is a file or directory. Returns an error if the path does not exist.
